title: A Sharp Fixed-Defect Conjecture for Fractional Gaussian Traces
problem_definition: For fractional Gaussian binomial series, is the integer trace at parameter $1/2$ coefficientwise at least the trace at $1/4$, for every positive integer index?
contribution: **Historical conjecture paper, not a solution.** Proposes a sharp ten-term fixed-defect correction, necessary already at index 13, and proves that its uniform validity would imply the trace comparison. Archived exact tests reach index 1004; independent reconstruction has explicitly smaller coverage. Stabilization proves the bounded-degree extension, not the full conjecture.

A Conjectural Unary-Theta Formula for the 6n+1-Section of 18-Colored Generalized Frobenius Partitions
problem_definition: Unproved conjecture in (Z/16Z)[[q]]: for Andrews's 18-colored generalized Frobenius partition function, sum_{m>=0} cphi_18(6m+1) q^m is congruent to 4*f_2*f_3^2/(f_1*f_6), equivalently 4*sum_{k in Z} q^{k(3k-1)/2}. The Jacobi-triple-product equality of the two right-hand expressions and their absence of exponents 3 or 4 modulo 5 are proved; the left-to-right congruence is not proved. Exact supporting computation covers 0<=m<=504, with 0<=m<=99 used for discovery and 100<=m<=504 held out.

title: A Newton-positivity conjecture for dyadic stages of reciprocal-subsum denominators
problem_definition: Explicitly unproved conjecture K_sharp_v1. Let D_N(x)=product_{i=1}^N(1+x^i)^{#{q>=0:2^q i<=N}}. For every integer j>=0 and every integer 1<=s<=j+1, let tau be the least t>=0 with s*2^t>=9 and 2*s*2^t>j+1. For t with s*2^t>=9 set a_{s,t}(x)=D_{s*2^t-1}(x) product_{ell=1}^{v_2(s)}(1+x^{s/2^ell}); coefficients are zero outside support. Set T_r(a)=a_r^2-a_{r-1}a_{r+1} and F_{s,j}(t)=2T_j(a_{s,t}(1+x^s))-T_j(a_{s,t})-T_{j-s}(a_{s,t}). Conjecture: Delta_t^h F_{s,j}(tau)>=0 for all integers 0<=h<=2j, where Delta has step one in t. Supporting established claims submitted for review: (i) the exact affine reduction and degree bound deg_u F(tau+u)<=2j; (ii) the complete exact certificate through j=96, yielding H at every actual stage for all n>=9 at indices 0<=j<=96 and their reflections, and original log-concavity for all n outside {3,5,6,7} when min(j,deg(D_n)-j)<=96; (iii) the generic positive band h=2j-k when j>=2k^2+k-1, with the top two Catalan formulas; (iv) for every n>=9 and every actual stage adding s at n=s*2^t, at j=2n-1 the actual value differs from its polynomial tail extrapolation by -a_{2n-2}-2a_{2n-s-2}<0, so every even forward difference of order at least 4n is negative. The boundary obstruction is outside K_sharp and is not a counterexample to H or to the original conjecture. K_sharp is not claimed equivalent to, or a complete proof of, the original all-n, all-index problem. All supporting statements, proof details and computational limits are specified in evidence/research3.md and its cited evidence.
